results.summary:
The page provides Anthropic Claude API pricing in USD, covering model, platform, and feature pricing. Key points:

- Models priced per token (Base Input, Output Tokens) with additional cache-related charges:
  - Standard Claude Opus, Sonnet, Haiku tiers listed (Opus 4.7/4.6/4.5, 4.1, 4; Sonnet 4.6/4.5; Haiku 4.5; 4.5 models are current; some older/deprecated notes exist).
  - Example base input pricing: Opus 4.x typically $5 per million tokens; Haiku 4.5 $1 per million; Sonnet around $3 per million; 4.1/4.0 higher.
  - Cache pricing: 5-minute cache write $1.25 per million tokens; 1-hour cache write $2 per million; cache read (hit) $0.10 per million; cache hits cost 10% of read value.
  - Output tokens priced similarly to input (e.g., Opus 4.x $25 per million).

- Cache multipliers: cache-related operations increase input pricing (5m write 1.25x, 1h write 2x, reads 0.1x).

- Cloud platform pricing:
  - Claude models available on cloud platforms (Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI) with platform-specific billing and regional endpoints.
  - Claude Platform on AWS pricing uses CCUs (Claude Consumption Units) billed via AWS Marketplace; conversion: USD token usage converted to CCUs at $0.01 per CCU, reported hourly.
  - Regional/multi-region endpoints incur a 10% premium over global endpoints.

- Other details:
  - For the most up-to-date pricing, refer to claude.com/pricing.
  - Data residency pricing and first-party data residency options apply to first-party Claude API usage.

- Note: Some older model versions are deprecated; pricing tables include base input, cache write, cache reads, and output token costs.
